text:
sara (AE): FYI Greenline POC starts Mon. Need a compact prompt inventory + baseline evals by EOD Fri. Can we lock scope and success criteria? :spiral_calendar:

matt (Sales-Eng): What are they validating first — quality, latency, cost?

sara (AE): Priority: 1) quality on 3 use cases (email summarize, product Q&A, rerank), 2) median token latency <500ms for short prompts, 3) token cost target <= $0.0008/generated token.

ana (Solutions): I'll own prompt inventory. Suggest buckets: summarize, extract_entities, answer_with_sources, rerank, instruction_following. Each bucket: 8-12 prompt templates + ~20 eval examples.

matt (Sales-Eng): Baseline eval config to share with infra: model=redwood-13b-quant, max_tokens=256, batch=16, metrics=[rouge-L,f1,ndcg,latency].

ana (Solutions): Example prompt templates: 
- Summarize: "Summarize the email into 2-3 bullets for a sales rep. Call out required actions."
- Q&A: "Using the docs below, answer concisely. If unknown, reply 'not in docs' and cite lines."

ryan (Security): SQA note: hosted API retains logs 30d by default (options 7/90/none). Dedicated supports customer KMS and no-logging. I'll draft a short SQA snippet and dataflow diagram.

sara (AE): Buyer asked pricing for a 30-day pilot at ~200k generated tokens/day: hosted vs dedicated?

matt (Sales-Eng): Rough: hosted @ $0.0009/token => ~$180/day (~$5.4k/mo). Dedicated sizing rough estimate $12k/mo for a 1x GPU pool that meets latency. Will confirm with finance.

ana (Solutions): POC acceptance criteria proposal: 
- Quality: rouge-L >=0.65 (summaries), F1 >=0.78 (extraction), NDCG@3 >=0.82 (rerank).
- Latency: p50 <500ms, p95 <1.2s (<=64-token prompts).
- Reliability: <1% error rate over 100k requests.
- Cost: token/unit <= target.

ryan (Security): Also need data deletion audit logs for enterprise; Dedicated/Private required for deletion guarantees. If they require HSM/KMS we need an NDA addendum and ~2-3 week lead time for on-prem prep.

sara (AE): Timeline: Fri EOD: prompt CSV + eval harness (ana + matt). Mon-Wed: run hosted baseline on 10k samples. Thu: review with Greenline and decide Hosted vs Dedicated.

dev-bot: build: eval harness container image pushed (sha:0f3a2c) to staging registry.

matt (Sales-Eng): Actions: cost sensitivity table (hosted vs dedicated vs hybrid), sizing notes for Dedicated, eval runner sample command.

ana (Solutions): I'll upload prompt CSV to sales drive with columns: bucket, prompt_template, example_input, expected_output, eval_label.

sara (AE): Ryan, can you confirm SQA snippet by Fri?

ryan (Security): Yep. Will post SQA snippet + dataflow diagram by Thu and call out lead times.

matt (Sales-Eng): Sample eval runner command: python eval_runner.py --model redwood-13b-quant --prompts prompts/summarize.csv --metrics rougeL,f1,latency --out results/summarize.json

ana (Solutions): Noting legal asked for deletion logs; flag in contract if Dedicated/Private required.

sara (AE): Agreed. We'll treat the acceptance metrics as POC success criteria unless buyer requests changes. Tagging @matt @ana @ryan. :white_check_mark:

matt (Sales-Eng): Confirmed. I'll post cost table here when ready.

ana (Solutions): Confirmed 12. Prompt CSV + eval examples will be uploaded.

ryan (Security): Confirmed. Will include minimal SQA answers and lead time callouts.

sara (AE): Thanks team 12 scheduling review with Greenline for next Thu.
